cmi.mod.name: Character Mod Isolation
cmi.page.title: Character Mod Isolation
cmi.page.desc: Vanilla-character runs hide all character-mod content. A character-mod run keeps the current character's mod and hides other character mods. Character mods stay enabled and selectable.
cmi.general.desc: Changes apply to the next run. The current run keeps its decision.
cmi.master.name: Enable isolation
cmi.master.desc: Off makes this mod do nothing.
cmi.source.name: Detection mode
cmi.source.desc: Automatic detects character mods. Manual skips detection and treats the mods you check as character mods.
cmi.verbose.name: Verbose log
cmi.verbose.desc: Logs every filter decision. Keep off unless diagnosing.
cmi.mods.desc: Automatic mode shows detected character mods. Manual mode treats checked mods as character mods.
cmi.mods.empty.desc: Disabled or unloaded mods are not shown.
cmi.rescan.name: Re-detect character mods
cmi.auto.manual: Manual mode: automatic detection is not running.
cmi.auto.title: Detected character mods
cmi.auto.title.desc: Only enabled mods are examined. The current character's mod is protected.
cmi.auto.status.pending: Detected; takes effect in an applicable run
cmi.manual.title: Enabled mods
cmi.manual.title.desc: Checked mods are treated as character mods. The current character's mod is protected.
